name: What is the process for professional shower drain cleaning?

mainEntity.name: What is the process for professional shower drain cleaning?

acceptedAnswer.text: When Alpha-Plumbing Services addresses a clogged shower drain, our process typically begins with an inspection to determine the clog's location and cause. This might involve using a specialized camera if the issue is not immediately apparent. For common clogs, we often use professional-grade drain snakes or augers to physically break apart and retrieve the blockage. For more stubborn or extensive buildups, hydro-jetting may be employed, which uses high-pressure water to thoroughly clean the pipe's interior. We aim to clear the clog effectively and ensure proper drainage, minimizing disruption to your home.
acceptedAnswer.description: Professional drain cleaning involves inspecting the clog, then using tools like drain snakes or hydro-jetting to clear the blockage and restore drainage.
